# talkdown

> talkdown is a small, no-install slide engine and Markdown format built for agents. A deck is one HTML file with Markdown in a `<script type="text/markdown">` block, loaded through https://sambhav.dev/talkdown/latest.js for automatic runtime updates, or direct deck.css/deck.js links for offline or pinned decks. The same source presents as 16:9 slides and reads as an article, where speaker notes become prose. Built-in widgets share the selected theme (23 themes, each light and dark), and custom HTML and JavaScript can join the deck's navigation.

Write notes in `::: notes` / `::: say` / `::: read` blocks and charts in `::: chart` containers with plain numbers. Use one HTML file by default; a referenced Markdown file works when served over HTTP. On phones, Previous/Next buttons move through steps and then slides; native scrolling stays enabled. A `?view=read#section-id` link opens the article at a named section. A `<div id="bar">` in the page (a `.title` plus links) replaces the default top bar. Custom scripts use `Talkdown.onReady(Deck => { ... })`.

## Agent instructions

- [talkdown skill](https://sambhav.dev/talkdown/skills/talkdown/SKILL.md): how to write a deck: boilerplate, syntax, every widget with its options, themes, rules and an example. Read this first.
- [talkdown skill (jsDelivr)](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/sambhav/talkdown@main/skills/talkdown/SKILL.md): same file, via CDN.

## Widgets

Grouped as in the skill, the README and the gallery. Stateful widgets step with ↓ and show everything in the article.

- Visual charts: `::: chart` (bar, horizontal bar, line, donut, heatmap, scatter, bubble, waterfall, timeline, Sankey, treemap, range) from one Markdown table or CSV; `::: quadrant`; `::: stats`; `::: meter` and `[1.2M]{count}`; inline `spark:9,8,8,6,5,5` sparklines; ✓ ◐ ✗ table marks.
- Interactive content: `::: tabs`, `::: toggle`, `::: accordion`, `::: steps`, `::: flip`, `::: compare` (before/after), `::: hotspots`, `::: quiz`, `::: explorable`, `::: glossary`, `{.explain}` tables, `::: timer`.
- Code and diagrams: copy buttons, stepped and annotated code, `terminal` fences, asciinema recordings, `log` and `diff` fences, `array` pointer steppers, `http` exchanges, `::: endpoint`, `::: prompt`, `::: chat`, `::: envdiff`, `[[Ctrl+K]]` keycaps, Mermaid, `::: flow` / `::: stack`, `::: browser` / `::: window` / `::: phone` frames, KaTeX maths and `$$ {steps}` equations.
- Presentation components: `::: features`, `::: speaker`, `::: timeline`, `::: board`, `::: changelog`, `::: links`, `::: gallery`, image slides, video, callouts, pull quotes, checklists, footnotes, sidenotes `text.[>note]`, Lucide `:icons:`, `::: agenda`, `::: ask`, `::: qr`.

## Docs and examples

- [README](https://github.com/sambhav/talkdown/blob/main/README.md): setup, authoring, syntax, widgets and themes.
- [Live demo](https://sambhav.dev/talkdown/): why the format exists, then live component examples and an authoring tour.
- [Widget gallery](https://sambhav.dev/talkdown/gallery.html): live widgets and chart types, grouped by category, each with its Markdown (press S).
- [Starter deck](https://sambhav.dev/talkdown/examples/starter.html): a minimal template to copy.

latest.js loads the current release each time a page opens, so published decks never need updating. For offline or pinned decks, link deck.js and deck.css directly (download them from sambhav.dev/talkdown or a GitHub release).
